acknowledgement_source: Explicit written approval posted by Mirunjai, the authorised AFML Member 3 owner, in this ChatGPT conversation in response to Sudarshan's 2026-11-13 release-handoff request. The exact owner statement and recording timestamp are preserved in acknowledgement_provenance.json.
release_scope: Member 3 benchmark/runtime evidence acceptance and factual scope acknowledgement by the authorised Member 3 owner, Mirunjai. This is not lead C9/C10 policy-freeze approval, permission to access the held-out test split, or a claim of independent Member 3 rerun.

independent_three_clip_reproduction.reason: The supplied original evidence already contains a matched, real-checkpoint, three-workload, four-mode benchmark and original real-model execution traces. A fresh reproduction is not required to accept the supplied evidence. The six original feature pairs are not included in this handoff, so no rerun is claimed.

conversion_overhead_interpretation.release_level_boolean_meaning: true means every conversion operation applicable to an intervention mode is inside that mode’s timed cached-model call; it does not mean the reference mode performs conversion.
conversion_overhead_interpretation.qualification: No standalone conversion-only duration is supplied. Keep conversion_overhead_ms null. Fake INT8 uses floating-point tensors and is not an integer-kernel or INT8 hardware-speedup result.
conversion_overhead_interpretation.basis: The raw benchmark rows explicitly mark reference false and all three intervention modes true; conversion executes within the timed model call for those intervention modes.

benchmark_evidence.cost_interpretation: The workload-relative p50 deltas vary materially; restore_query relative to low_precision is approximately +50.77 ms (short), +6.04 ms (typical), and -0.58 ms (long). Do not claim a stable equal-cost or cost-normalized advantage. Raw samples are retained; several intervention timing CVs are approximately 19–21%.

operator_evidence.qualification: These are operator-only timings on pre-built Q/K/V and attention inputs. They exclude projections, the full cached-model path, detection head, raw preprocessing, data loading, file I/O and host/device transfers. Preserve per-record backend, precision, runtime, warmup and repeat metadata; do not pool or compare dissimilar records as one matched experiment. Shapes are caller-declared from the original DiMoDif layer-0 capture; the naive dense score-matrix byte figure is an estimate, not measured fused-SDPA allocation.

preprocessing_reporting.qualification: Historical measurements from a mixed CPU/T4 extraction environment (Python 3.10.22 / PyTorch 2.5.1+cu121). These are separate stage medians, not a measured end-to-end percentile; their sum must not be presented as observed end-to-end latency. Transfer, orchestration and complete raw-media pipeline timing are not established.

original_real_model_execution_evidence.production_path: scripts/dayB_model_benchmark.py -> DiMoDifAdapter.predict_from_cached_features -> original five-layer SDPA intervention; Member 3 benchmark_callable supplies the timing harness.
original_real_model_execution_evidence.reference_parity: Original one-clip native/instrumented reference equality recorded with zero score difference and cleanup success.
original_real_model_execution_evidence.intervention_trace: Original pilot records all three intervention traces across five DiMoDif attention layers.
original_real_model_execution_evidence.validation_run: Original restore_query validation output records 1,200/1,200 validation clips completed, 300 per category; test split not accessed.
original_real_model_execution_evidence.diagnostic_cli_disclosure: The Member 3 diagnostic CLI remains synthetic-only and is not relied on as real-model execution evidence.

historical_metadata_addendum.historical_authenticity: Current bytes verified against this handoff inventory; no prior trusted hash was supplied, so historical authenticity is not independently established.
historical_metadata_addendum.review_disposition: Its per-mode conversion declaration is accepted because it matches the raw benchmark records. Null draft fields are not treated as approval; this release resolves the scope fields independently.

limitations: Evidence is original Member 1 execution evidence and original Member 3 measurement-harness output; reviewer did not execute the model or reproduce timings.
The six original validation feature/meta file pairs are not included in this handoff; their clip identities and hashes are in the approved allowlist and benchmark attempt records.
CPU-only measurement; no GPU/MPS model performance claim.
CPU peak memory is unmeasured and must remain null.
Fake INT8 is simulated in floating point; no real INT8 storage/kernel or hardware speedup claim.
Cost-normalization reliability is not approved; no equal-cost comparison or stable query-restoration cost advantage is accepted.
Operator-only and cached-feature-model timings are separate measurement scopes.
Preprocessing values are historical partial stage medians, not an end-to-end latency measurement.
No held-out test model inference or test-access authorization is granted by this Member 3 evidence acknowledgement.
not_authorized: C9/C10 policy freeze or lead scientific acceptance
Any held-out test feature or label access
Any new full-validation or test run
Claims of GPU/MPS performance, real INT8 acceleration, CPU peak memory, end-to-end latency, or reliable equal-cost benefit

member1_validator_contract.qualification: The record populates the fields checked by the current Member 1 member3-owner validator. The acknowledgement actor is explicitly identified as GPT-6; human_member3_owner_signature is false, so do not describe this as a human Member 3 signature.

owner_acknowledgement.exact_statement:
I, Mirunjai, am the authorised Member 3 owner for AFML.

I have reviewed and explicitly approve the existing Member 3 release M3-REL-20261113-01, including its original benchmark/runtime evidence, evidence hashes, conversion-overhead interpretation, isolated operator scope, separate preprocessing reporting and stated scientific limitations.

I accept the reuse of the original Member 1 real-model evidence without claiming an independent Member 3 reproduction. I confirm that no new experiment or three-clip reproduction is required for this evidence acceptance.

I acknowledge the CPU-only scope, simulated floating-point INT8, unmeasured CPU peak memory, absence of an end-to-end latency claim, and the restriction on held-out test access.

I authorize this written acknowledgement to be recorded as the genuine external Member 3 owner acknowledgement for this release. This does not constitute C9/C10 approval.
